name: Pixlora Elements – Widgets & Theme Builder for Elementor
author: Kiran

sections.description:
Pixlora Elements extends the free Elementor page builder with:

  • A dedicated Pixlora widget category containing site logo, nav menu, social icons, copyright, button, link list, search form and theme-builder widgets (post title, post content, post excerpt, featured image, post meta, post comments, archive title, archive posts).
  • A Header & Footer builder: design headers, footers, single, archive, search and 404 templates with Elementor and assign them with display conditions.
  • A bundled, fully offline preset library for quickly starting header, footer and body templates. No external or remote requests are made at any point.

This plugin requires the Elementor plugin to be installed and active.

Pixlora Elements is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Elementor Ltd. “Elementor” is a trademark of its respective owner and is used here only to describe compatibility.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Elementor plugin.
  2. Upload the pixlora-elements folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate Pixlora Elements through the Plugins screen.
  4. Create templates under Pixlora Templates and edit them with Elementor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin call any external services?

No. All presets ship inside the plugin and everything renders locally.

Does it work without Elementor Pro?

Yes. Header, footer and body templates are applied through standard WordPress template hooks, so no Pro add-on is needed.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Change: Renamed to “Pixlora Elements – Widgets & Theme Builder for Elementor” (slug and text domain: pixlora-elements).
  • Fix: Activation no longer fails when Elementor is active.
  • Fix: All output is escaped late with wp_kses()/wp_kses_post().

1.1.1

  • Change: Elementor is now a required dependency; activation is blocked until Elementor is active. Requires WordPress 6.5+.
  • Removed: Example “Hello” widget.

1.1.0

  • New: Completely redesigned header and footer preset library with five premium matched pairs (Noir Luxe, Aurora Glass, Editorial, Split Mint, Sunset Studio).
  • Fix: Body templates no longer replace the content area inside the Elementor editor preview or core post previews.
  • Fix: Template Settings meta box script is now properly enqueued instead of printed inline.
  • Fix: Resolved all WordPress Plugin Check errors and warnings.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
